subject: SKU-tiered PO waiver framework and delegated approval plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@patchworks.io>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@patchworks.io
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SKU-based small-order PO exemption for pilot

Hi Tessa,

Quick note from the PatchWorks procurement team as we scope the Redwood pilot next month — we have ~120 SKUs that will be ordered sporadically by our field engineers. For SKUs under $250 per order we’d like to request a standing waiver from the PO requirement to enable faster ad-hoc purchases (our internal process is slow and will block the pilot ramp).

High level:
- Estimated volume: 40–60 small orders/month during pilot
- Typical order size: $40–220
- Vendor: Redwood (hosted API access + integration support)

We’re happy to provide an initial SKU list and accept a monthly consolidated invoice if that helps Redwood’s AP. Can we set expectations for what evidence you need and whether this can be approved under a delegated authority for the trial? I attached a CSV of SKUs and average unit prices.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Rossi | Head of Procurement, PatchWorks
elena.rossi@patchworks.io | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: patchworks-sku-list.csv (text/csv, 23KB)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@patchworks.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SKU-based small-order PO exemption for pilot

Elena —

Thanks for the fast context and the SKU list, that helps. Looping in Marissa (AE for PatchWorks) and Lauren (Finance lead) to align on risk and operational mechanics. A few quick signals from our side:

- We’re open to a temporary PO exemption for low-dollar SKU purchases during a defined pilot window (typically 60–90 days).
- We need controls: consolidated monthly invoice OR pre-authorized charge limit per SKU, and an itemized delivery/receipts requirement to support GL coding.
- Delegated approval possibility: for purchases under $250, we can explore authorizing PatchWorks procurement to approve up to $5k/month via an approved vendor contact, subject to a signed addendum and periodic review. Lauren — can you confirm whether Finance is comfortable with a consolidated monthly invoice and the suggested $5k/month cap as a mitigation?

Proposed next steps:
1) Lauren to confirm accounting controls and preferred evidence fields (invoice format, PO-exemption addendum).
2) Marissa and I to draft a short waiver addendum (1–2 pages) with SKU thresholds and review cadence.
3) Elena to confirm legal or internal audit needs on your side.

If that works, I’ll draft the addendum and attach a proposed waiver template for sign-off.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
T: (628) 555-0198

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@patchworks.io>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@patchworks.io
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SKU-based small-order PO exemption for pilot

Thanks Tessa — that plan sounds reasonable. A few clarifications from our side:

- Consolidated invoice is preferred (one monthly invoice with line items per delivery).
- PatchWorks internal audit requires: SKU code, quantity, unit price, end-user site, and a brief justification line for each line item (we can populate this).
- We can accept an initial $5k/month cap for the first 60 days; after that we’d want a monthly review and potential rebaseline.

I attached a short internal note on their preferred invoice fields and the CSV you already have. No legal hold on our side for this pilot — procurement can sign an addendum.

Elena

Attachments: proposed-waiver-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 12KB)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@patchworks.io>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SKU-based small-order PO exemption for pilot — internal sign-off and rollout plan

Team — following Elena’s confirmation, Finance and CS alignment below so we can respond with an operational playbook to PatchWorks: 

Summary decision (proposed):
- Approve temporary SKU-tiered PO waiver for PatchWorks pilot (60 days) for orders < $250, aggregated cap $5,000/month.
- Accept consolidated monthly invoice with required line-item fields (SKU, qty, unit price, end-user site, justification).
- PatchWorks procurement will be the delegated approver; addendum signed by their procurement and Redwood finance required.

Operational steps (owner):
- Marissa: draft addendum and client-facing one-page playbook (due 2026-07-02 COB).
- Lauren: confirm GL mapping and AP process for consolidated invoices; provide AP contact and any required invoice template (due 2026-07-02).
- Markus: run a quick risk check (vendor abuse, chargeback risk) and confirm we don’t need additional holdbacks (due 2026-07-02).
- Tessa: coordinate sign-off and schedule a 30-minute handoff call with PatchWorks for 2026-07-06.

Notes/constraints:
- If monthly invoiced amount exceeds $5k, we will automatically require POs for the excess and pause the waiver for subsequent month until reviewed.
- Waiver applies only to the SKUs in the attached CSV; adding new SKUs requires a confirmation email from PatchWorks procurement.

Elena — if you’re good with the above I’ll send the formal draft addendum and playbook this afternoon.

Thanks —
Tessa

---
Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
